goal: Implement BIP 54 consensus cleanup validation rules on regtest without activating them on mainnet
Fix known consensus flaws including legacy sigop CPU exhaustion, Merkle tree collisions, and timewarp attacks
agreement: Broad support with multiple ACKs on consensus logic and tests (instagibbs, optout21, theStack)
Extensively tested against external tools and mutant testing (fametrano, ViniciusCestarii, instagibbs)
Concept approval across multiple contributors (0xB10C, dergoegge, fanquake, fjahr)
Open questions regarding coinbase validation paths, compact blocks, and test edge cases (ariard)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it addresses critical consensus flaws like CPU exhaustion, CVE-2017-12842, and timewarp attacks
It provides a tested implementation to evaluate consensus cleanup before any potential network deployment
Impact is initially confined to regtest while establishing core consensus logic for future activation
